newsitem.title: USA: Emons names Alfred Smith president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Emons names Alfred Smith president/COO.

text.p: Emons Transportation Group Inc said Wednesday Alfred Smith was promoted to the new position of president and chief operating officer and Scott Ziegler was promoted to vice president-finance.
Ziegler will retain his current responsibilities as controller and secretary.

Smith, previously executive vice president, has been with Emons for fifteen years in various capacities, and for the past two years had been assigned to head-up the company's New England Business Unit, a statement from the company said.
The positions taken over by Smith had been held by Robert Grossman, who will remain as chairman and chief executive officer, enabling him to focus on strategic planning, the company said.

Smith, 42, brings extensive industry experience to his new position, Emons said. He will be responsible for existing operations and for the start-up of any new rail properties that might be acquired, the company said.
